parsed.note_claim: Speed tapes are widely used for quick, temporary repairs on aircraft exteriors.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Speed tape is an aluminium pressure-sensitive tape used to perform minor repairs on aircraft and racing cars. It is used as a temporary repair material until a more permanent repair can be carried out.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly defines speed tape as used for minor aircraft repairs and states it is temporary until permanent repairs are made.
